$comment: THE PREDICATE VOCABULARY — one source of truth, read by three layers.
ADR-0009 makes a widget a question whose diagnostic predicates are its
distractors. A predicate is the name of a structural thing that can be true
about a student's construction: 'both ends are on the circle', 'the slope is
inverted', 'the stroke doubles back'. The widget computes which one fired;
the stored question maps it to a misconception_id; the server serves that
misconception's refutation.
That only works if all three layers agree on the spelling, so this file is
the authority and nobody hardcodes the list:
app/src/lib/widget-predicates.ts   generated from here, checked in CI
services/extraction/widget_spec.py reads this file directly
the DB stores predicates inside questions.choices, validated on load
'ok' is reserved in every kind: it is the predicate that means correct, and
it is what questions.correct_answer holds for a widget row.
Adding a predicate is additive and safe. RENAMING one silently breaks the
mapping on every stored question that used it, so rename by adding the new
spelling, migrating the rows, then removing the old one.
CAN EMIT (consistency review 2026-09-27, W1). A kind declares every predicate it knows, but a
given question emits only some of them: line_drawer in 'points' mode can never report a slope,
angle_setter asked for the INSCRIBED angle can never report 'angle-given-as-arc'. A mapping on
a predicate the question cannot emit is dead — it never fires, and the student gets a plain
'not quite' where a refutation was promised. 'can_emit' is, per kind, what the app's grading
code can actually return (derived from the file named in 'can_emit_source'): either a list, or
{"by": <spec field>, "cases": {<value>: <node>}} dispatching on the question's stored spec
("(absent)" when the field is missing, "(present)" when it holds an object). A spec value
with no case is one the widget does not render. 'ok' is never listed: every widget can emit it.
Mirrored in app/src/lib/widget-predicates.ts (WIDGET_CAN_EMIT, checked by its test) and enforced
by services/extraction/widget_spec.validate_widget on active AND held mappings.

predicates.swapped-coordinates: Plotted (y, x) — the pair read in the wrong order
predicates.wrong-quadrant: Right distances, wrong signs — the point is in the wrong quadrant
predicates.off-target: Neither coordinate matches, with no recognisable pattern

predicates.reversed-pairs: Built Y×X — the pairs are the right numbers in the wrong order
predicates.missing-pairs: An incomplete product: some pairs of X×Y were not selected
predicates.extra-pairs: Selected pairs that are not in X×Y at all

product_builder.can_emit_source: ProductBuilder.tsx check() — a wrong pick is always reported as reversed-pairs, so extra-pairs is never emitted

predicates.slope-inverted: Slope taken as run over rise instead of rise over run
predicates.slope-sign-flipped: Right gradient, wrong sign — the line leans the other way
predicates.intercept-wrong: Correct slope, wrong intercept — a line parallel to the answer
predicates.vertical-line: A vertical line, which has no slope and cannot be written y = mx + c
predicates.points-swapped: The named points plotted with x and y exchanged
predicates.off-target: Neither the slope nor the intercept matches

predicates.ends-not-on-circle: One or both endpoints are not on the circle
predicates.chord-not-through-centre: A chord was drawn where a diameter was asked for — it misses the centre
predicates.radius-drawn-as-chord: Both ends on the circle where a radius was asked for; a radius starts at the centre
predicates.radius-short: Starts at the centre but does not reach the circle
predicates.is-secant: The line cuts the circle twice — a secant, not a tangent
predicates.is-external: The line misses the circle completely
predicates.off-target: The construction does not satisfy the element asked for

predicates.arc-given-as-angle: Gave the arc where the inscribed angle was asked for — the angle is half the arc
predicates.angle-given-as-arc: Gave the inscribed angle where the central angle or arc was asked for — the arc is double
predicates.other-arc: Set the arc on the far side; C faces the arc across from it
predicates.off-target: The angle is not the one asked for, with no recognisable pattern

predicates.ratio-inverted: The right pair of sides, the wrong way up
predicates.used-sine: Built the sine where another ratio was asked for
predicates.used-cosine: Built the cosine where another ratio was asked for
predicates.used-tangent: Built the tangent where another ratio was asked for
predicates.off-target: The ratio does not match and is not a recognised substitution

triangle_ratio.can_emit_source: TriangleRatio.tsx check() — legs are whole numbers 1..12, so sin and cos are always below 1 and 1/reading can never equal a sin or cos target: ratio-inverted fires only for tan

predicates.median-for-mean: Built a set whose MEDIAN is the target — the mean is the total shared equally
predicates.mean-for-median: Built a set whose MEAN is the target — the median is the middle value in order
predicates.no-mode: No value repeats, so the set has no mode at all
predicates.multi-modal: Two or more values tie at the top, so the set has more than one mode
predicates.total-wrong: For this mean across n values the total must be mean x n, and it is not
predicates.off-target: The statistic does not match the target

bar_builder.can_emit_source: BarBuilder.tsx check() — every wrong mean that is not the median is total-wrong, so a mean never reports off-target

predicates.missed-values: Part of the answer set was not marked
predicates.extra-values: Marked values that the answer set does not contain
predicates.sign-flipped: Right sizes, wrong signs — a value marked as its negative, as when (x − a) = 0 is read as x = −a
predicates.endpoint-inclusion-wrong: Right endpoints, wrong circles — hollow excludes (< >), filled includes (<= >=)
predicates.interval-wrong: The interval does not run between the right endpoints
predicates.off-target: Wrong in a way none of the named errors describes

predicates.inverse-solved-as-direct: Matched the quotients where the products should match
predicates.direct-solved-as-inverse: Matched the products where the quotients should match
predicates.off-target: The fourth term does not balance the relationship

predicates.missed-outcomes: Some outcomes in the event were not selected
predicates.extra-outcomes: Selected outcomes that do not satisfy the event
predicates.counted-once: Counted a compound outcome once where the grid shows several ways to make it

predicates.fails-vertical-line-test: The stroke doubles back: one x carries two y values, so it is not a function
predicates.opens-wrong-way: The parabola opens the opposite way — the sign of a
predicates.slope-sign-flipped: The line rises where it should fall, or the reverse
predicates.vertically-displaced: Right shape, sitting consistently above or below the true curve
predicates.partial-coverage: The sketch covers only part of the visible domain
predicates.asymptote-crossed: The stroke runs straight through where the curve is undefined, as if it were continuous there
predicates.wrong-quadrants: The hyperbola's branches sit in the wrong pair of quadrants — the sign of a
predicates.wrong-intercept: The curve does not pass through its true y-intercept
predicates.amplitude-wrong: The curve reaches the wrong distance from its midline
predicates.period-wrong: The curve repeats at the wrong rate for this function
predicates.vertical-shift-wrong: The curve is centred on the wrong midline
predicates.off-target: The sketch does not follow the curve

curve_sketcher.can_emit_source: curve-sketcher-grade.ts gradeCurve() — asymptote-crossed only where the family has an asymptote (hyperbola, tangent: vertical; exponential: horizontal)

predicates.only-one-pair-parallel: That is a trapezium — only one pair of opposite sides is parallel
predicates.sides-not-equal: The sides that must be equal for this shape are not
predicates.no-right-angle: None of the interior angles is a right angle
predicates.midsegment-not-half: Parallel to the third side, but not half its length
predicates.area-missing-half: Exactly double the target — the ÷2 was left out of the area formula
predicates.not-the-shape: The construction does not have the property this shape needs

predicates.volume-scaled-by-k: The scale factor was applied once (k), not cubed (k³) — a linear length scaling used for a volume
predicates.area-scaled-by-k: The scale factor was applied once (k), not squared (k²) — a linear length scaling used for an area
predicates.wrong-formula-part: The scale factor is right, but a face — usually a base — is missing from the surface-area reading
predicates.off-target: Neither the scale factor nor the surface reading matches

solid_scaler.can_emit_source: solid-scaler-grade.ts gradeVolumeScale / gradeAreaScale + SolidScaler.tsx FACES (a sphere has no face toggle, so its area is never wrong-formula-part)

predicates.median-of-unsorted: The middle of the data as GIVEN, not the middle once it is sorted
predicates.iqr-as-range: The lower and upper quartiles were placed at the minimum and maximum — the interquartile range rebuilt as the full range
predicates.quartile-method: A different quartile method was used (splitting at the median) — this book uses linear interpolation between ranks
predicates.whisker-to-outlier: A whisker was dragged out to a raw outlier instead of stopping at the last value within 1.5×IQR
predicates.off-target: The five-number summary does not match, with no recognisable pattern

predicates.overlap-counted-twice: A region's raw set size was entered instead of the count exclusive to it — the overlap counted in twice
predicates.intersection-for-union: The intersection was shaded (or counted) where the union was asked for
predicates.complement-inside-a: The complement was shaded inside the set it complements, rather than everywhere outside it
predicates.exclusive-drawn-overlapping: "X only" was shaded including its overlap with another set
predicates.neither-region-missed: The region outside every set was left unshaded or uncounted
predicates.off-target: Wrong in a way none of the named errors describes

venn_builder.can_emit_source: venn-builder-grade.ts gradeVennShade / gradeVennCounts (overlap-counted-twice needs the word problem's clues)

predicates.missing-cross-term: The x tiles were skipped — only x² and the constant are there, as in (a+b)² read as a² + b²
predicates.middle-term-sign: The constant term is right and the linear (x) term is not — usually its sign
predicates.constant-sign: The linear (x) term is right and the constant term is not — usually its sign
predicates.not-a-rectangle: The placed tiles do not tile a rectangle: a gap, a stray tile, or more than one x² tile
predicates.off-target: A valid rectangle whose terms match neither the target sum nor its product

area_model.can_emit_source: area-model-grade.ts gradeAreaModel() — expand and factor are graded alike
